rows.corpus_definition: To protect things so they are not wasted or destroyed.
rows.example_en: It is important to save water during the dry summer.

rows.corpus_definition: happening all the time without any pause or stop
rows.example_en: There was a constant noise from traffic.

rows.corpus_definition: To build something large like a house or bridge.
rows.example_en: They will construct a new school nearby.

rows.corpus_definition: Easily passed from one person to another by touch.
rows.example_en: The doctor said his sickness was very contagious.

rows.corpus_definition: Related to the current time period.
rows.example_en: This museum displays interesting contemporary art.

rows.corpus_definition: Showing that something is the complete opposite of what was said.
rows.example_en: The evidence proved the contrary of his story.

rows.corpus_definition: A lot of public disagreement about a topic.
rows.example_en: The new law caused a lot of controversy.

rows.corpus_definition: To make someone believe that your idea is correct.
rows.example_en: I could not convince him to come with us.

rows.corpus_definition: To manage to deal with a difficult situation.
rows.example_en: She learned how to cope with heavy stress.

rows.corpus_definition: The most important or central part of something.
rows.example_en: This issue lies at the core of our problem.
